FACT_ID: sec12-R01 | anchor: A01
Experience, not reading, makes safe drivers, while starting steps vary by car and manual [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint starting; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec12-F01 and sec12-F02.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec12-R02 | anchor: A01
Park, Reverse, Neutral, and Drive pick directions, while Low caps gears and may read 3, 2, 1 [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint shifting; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec12-F03 and sec12-F04.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec12-R03 | anchor: A02
Manuals climb gears through the clutch, while the three-beat clutch dance also downshifts and reverses [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint shifting; prereq_hint sec12-F03; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec12-F05 and sec12-F06.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0040]

FACT_ID: sec12-R04 | anchor: A02
Gentle throttle grips, while jackrabbit starts spin and skid [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint accel-brake; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec12-F08.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0040]

FACT_ID: sec12-R05 | anchor: A02
Car bulk and reflexes set stops, while reaction plus braking sums tabled feet per speed [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint stopping; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec12-F09 and sec12-F11.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0040]

FACT_ID: sec12-R06 | anchor: A03
Three-to-four-second gaps suit fair weather only, while beginners hold three and veterans may hold two [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint gaps; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec12-F13 and sec12-F14.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0041]

FACT_ID: sec12-R07 | anchor: A03
Speed and slick stretch gaps to five or six-plus seconds, while ABS wants a stomped held pedal [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint gaps; prereq_hint sec12-F13; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec12-F15 and sec12-F16.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0041]

FACT_ID: sec12-R08 | anchor: A03
Brake taps telegraph surprise slows, while signs and red lights always command halts [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint stops; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec12-F17 and sec12-F18.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0041]

FACT_ID: sec12-R09 | anchor: A03
Drives, officers, and flaggers command halts, while blind pedestrians command them too [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint stops; prereq_hint sec12-F18; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec12-F19 and sec12-F20.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0041]

FACT_ID: sec12-R10 | anchor: A04
Limits cap ideal-road speed, while sixty triples thirty's stopping room [A04].
Why it matters: group_hint speed; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec12-F22.
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0042]

FACT_ID: sec12-R11 | anchor: A04
Business, home, and suburb bands cap at 20, 25, and 45, while towing shares 45 [A04].
Why it matters: group_hint unposted; prereq_hint sec12-F22; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec12-F23.
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0042]

FACT_ID: sec12-R12 | anchor: A04
Secondary, primary, and rural interstate bands cap at 50, 60, and 70, while lower postings may dip any band [A04].
Why it matters: group_hint unposted; prereq_hint sec12-F23; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec12-F24.
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0042]

FACT_ID: sec12-R13 | anchor: A04
Crawlers match flow and shun interstates under 40, while grippers hold 9-and-3 or 7-and-5 [A04].
Why it matters: group_hint speed-steer; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec12-F25 and sec12-F26.
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0042]

FACT_ID: sec12-R14 | anchor: A04
Far scans pre-plan steering with hand techniques, while palm spins and finger slips court loss [A04].
Why it matters: group_hint steering; prereq_hint sec12-F26; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec12-F27 and sec12-F28.
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0042]
